label: GDP growth (annual %)
methodologyNotes: World Bank indicator NY.GDP.MKTP.KD.ZG: annual percentage growth rate of GDP at market prices, based on constant local currency, aggregated from national accounts data compiled by World Bank staff.
licenseOrReuseNotes: CC-BY 4.0 (World Bank Open Data default license), confirmed via https://datacatalog.worldbank.org/public-licenses on 2026-07-09. Requires attribution and noting any changes made.

label: Population, total
methodologyNotes: World Bank indicator SP.POP.TOTL: de facto population count (all residents regardless of legal status/citizenship), compiled from national censuses, population registers, and UN Population Division estimates.
licenseOrReuseNotes: CC-BY 4.0 (World Bank Open Data default license), confirmed via https://datacatalog.worldbank.org/public-licenses on 2026-07-09. Requires attribution and noting any changes made.

label: Forest area (% of land area)
methodologyNotes: World Bank indicator AG.LND.FRST.ZS: land under natural or planted stands of trees, whether productive or not, as a share of total land area — compiled from UN Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) data.
licenseOrReuseNotes: CC-BY 4.0 (World Bank Open Data default license), confirmed via https://datacatalog.worldbank.org/public-licenses on 2026-07-09. Requires attribution and noting any changes made.

label: Agricultural land (% of land area)
methodologyNotes: World Bank indicator AG.LND.AGRI.ZS: share of land area used for crops, pasture, and fallow land, as a share of total land area — compiled from FAO data.
licenseOrReuseNotes: CC-BY 4.0 (World Bank Open Data default license), confirmed via https://datacatalog.worldbank.org/public-licenses on 2026-07-09. Requires attribution and noting any changes made.

label: Annual average temperature at 2m (Washington, D.C.)
geography: Washington, D.C., USA (38.9072, -77.0369) — a single point, not a global average
methodologyNotes: Annual value is NASA POWER's own native annual average for the year (the API's "13th month" key), not computed by this project.
licenseOrReuseNotes: NASA content is generally in the U.S. public domain / not copyrighted; attribution requested but not legally required for non-commercial/educational use, per https://www.nasa.gov/nasa-brand-center/images-and-media/ (checked 2026-07-09). No POWER-specific data-rights page was found (checked, 404); this is NASA's general policy, applied as the best available source.

label: Global M5.5+ earthquake count
methodologyNotes: Monthly value is a count of raw USGS catalog events in that calendar month at or above M5.5, computed by this project's fetcher (not a resampling of an existing series — the catalog has no other native frequency). The in-progress current month is excluded.
licenseOrReuseNotes: U.S. Public Domain — USGS-authored data/products are public domain per https://www.usgs.gov/information-policies-and-instructions/copyrights-and-credits (checked 2026-07-09). Credit requested: "U.S. Geological Survey".

label: English Wikipedia total monthly pageviews
methodologyNotes: Uses Wikimedia's agent=user filter, a heuristic attempt to exclude bot/crawler traffic — imperfect, not a guarantee of human-only views.
licenseOrReuseNotes: CC0 (public domain dedication) — Wikimedia's Analytics datasets (including pageviews) are CC0 unless otherwise specified, per https://dumps.wikimedia.org/legal.html (checked 2026-07-09).

label: Individuals using the Internet (% of population)
methodologyNotes: World Bank indicator IT.NET.USER.ZS: share of individuals who used the internet (from any device) in the last 3 months, compiled from International Telecommunication Union (ITU) data.
licenseOrReuseNotes: CC-BY 4.0 (World Bank Open Data default license), confirmed via https://datacatalog.worldbank.org/public-licenses on 2026-07-09. Requires attribution and noting any changes made.
